    LargeIndecomposable.AR.haradaSai

    The category of finite-dimensional modules; the Harada–Sai lemma #

    FDMod k A: A-modules that are finite-dimensional over k, with A-linear maps.

    haradaSai: in a chain X₀ → X₁ → ⋯ → X_m of indecomposables of dimension ≤ b whose maps are not bijective, the composite is zero once m ≥ 2ᵇ − 1.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.AR.FDMod (k A : Type u) [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] :
    Type (u + 1)

    A finite-dimensional A-module.

    • carrier : Type u
    • isAddCommGroup : AddCommGroup self.carrier
    • isModule : Module A self.carrier
    • isModuleK : Module k self.carrier
    • isScalarTower : IsScalarTower k A self.carrier
    • isFD : FiniteDimensional k self.carrier
